hymns.title: Habaye umunsi

lines.text: Yesu yitanga ngo agere mu isi;

hymns.title: Iki gihe turimo

lines.text: Iki gihe turimo ni icy’ibibazo, ku baremwe bose
Umuntu wese yibaza ku by’iki gihe, ntabone igisubizo
Ni muri Yesu, ni muri Yesu,
Amahoro yo mu isi yabaye make ku bw’ibyaha by’abantu

hymns.title: Ninde mu baremwe

lines.text: Ninde mu baremwe bose wabera umuntu icyitegererezo

hymns.title: Mwami wanjye

lines.text: Iyi si ndimo siho iwacu, ahubwo ndi umugenzi,

lines.text: Ndashimira Umwami wacu Yesu, kuko yangiriye imbabazii

hymns.title: Nyobora inzira Mwami

lines.text: Nyobora inzira izangeza, mu rurembo rw’ijuru Siyoni

hymns.title: Amahoro yo mu ijuru

lines.text: Amahoro yo mu ijuru, anyuzuye mu mutima
Reka ndirimbe mpimbaza, uwaremye ijuru n’isi n’inyanja
Yumvise gutaka kwanjye, ambohora ingoyi z’ibyaha
Nuko anyuzuza n’Imana, Yesu niwe wabimpereye ubuntu.
Na gakondo yo mu ijuru untegurira ngo tuzabanemo
Sinzakuvirira Mwami, naho nabura ibyo mfite byose
Ndashaka kujyana nawe, aho ujya hose nzagukurikira
Cya gihe wayiciyemo nanjye ndagukurikira Mukiza.
Have yewe wa bwoba we namaramaje kujyana na Yesu
Unyobore mu kwizera kuko iyi isi iri inyuma y’ibicu
Ntacyatuma ntinya urupfu kuko ari rwo rembo ryo kwinjira
Muri cya gihugu cyiza waringanirije abakwiringira

Ni ho inshuti zose za Mesiya zizateranira
Niho hazava amategeko azategeka ya si nshya.

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim,1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1997
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Haleluya ushimwe Yesu

lines.text: Ha ha ha /3 Haleluya /2 Haa haa haa haa
Kuko nta yindi Mana yakoze nk’ibyo wakoze,
Bushima izina ryawe kuko uri Imana y’igitangaza
Cya gihe Yesu yari aryamye mu bwato
Umwami w’abami yavuze ijambo rimwe inyanja iratuza
Mbese ni nde wahangana na we ?
Si rimwe cyangwa si kabiri duhura n’ibyago,
Ntahandi tubukura atari mu izina rya Yesu
Watsinze Satani, Data, Yesu uri Umwami
Ukwiye icyubahiro, uri Umwami, uri Umwami Yesu
Ukwiye gupfukamirwa, uri Umwami, ooh Yesu

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961 - ,
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Komeza usenge Imana

lines.text: Tugeze mu gihe kiruhije abantu bose
None benedata muze twegere Imana yacu
Komeza usenge Imana, guma mu masengesho
Womatane na we maze mubane akaramata
Nutangira gusenga jya ushima Imana kubwe
Mu gitondo cya kare jya wiragiza Imana
Senga ugenda mu nzira jya usenga uri mu mirimo
Senga uri mu nzu yawe, byuka nijoro usenge
Akagutera ubwoba y’uko Imana itumva ibyawe

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1996
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Mbese izina ryanjye

lines.text: Mbese izina ryanjye ryanditswe mu gitabo ?
Mwami Yesu icyo nicyo nifuza kumenya
Mbese izina ryanjye ryanditswe mu gitabo ?
Ahubwo icyo nkwiriye kwifuza cya mbere
Ni ukumenywa na Yesu maze akanyandika
No kuririmba neza nabyo nta kamaro
Ni uko izina ryanjye ryandikwa mu gitabo

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na MOSHI Samson, 1958 - ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1987
hymns.author: MOSHI Samson

hymns.title: Mfite umukunzi

lines.text: Uwo mukunzi mbabwira, ntawundi uhwanye na we
Yitwa Imanweli intare yo mu muryango wa Yuda

hymns.credit: Yaririmbwe n’ Alexis DUSABE, 1978 -
hymns.author: Alexis DUSABE

hymns.title: Twakijijwe ku bw’ubuntu

lines.text: Mwuka Wera ni we utwemeza, akatwereka ibyaha byacu
Amaraso y’Umwami Yesu, ni yo atweza ibyaha byose

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe n’Itsinda ry’abahimbyi
hymns.author: Itsinda ry’abahimbyi

hymns.title: Ubwo wajyaga mu ijuru

lines.text: Ubwo wajyaga mu ijuru wakingirijwe n’ibicu,
Ariko biranditswe ngo uko wagiye mu ijuru,
Mwami ni ko uzagaruka ndetse urazana n’ibicu.
Mwese mugire ihumure mwikomeze mu mitima
Nimwubure imitwe yanyu mutumbire iyo mu bicu
Dore arazana n’ibicu nk’uko byari byaranditswe
Ese ni ryari uzagaruka uhagarare ku bicu ?
Nibwo nzabwira iyi isi nti ‘‘yewe wa si we urabeho’’
Mpindukirane Satani nti ‘‘umva yewe Satani we
Sigarana iyi si yawe jyewe ndagiye mu ijuru’’
Sigarana iyi si yawe njyewe ndagiye mu ijuru
Nzasohoka mu mubiri mpite nambikwa kudapfa
Ukiri mu isi waririye umurwa Yerusalemu
Mwami Yesu reba uko ab’iki gihe biyobagiza
Bafite izina ry’uko bariho kandi barapfuye
Barandata impumyi nabo baramaze kuba impumyi
Imirimo ye iri mu mayoberane gusa gusa,
Uyu munsi mutoranye uwo mukwiye gukorera
Ari Umwami Yesu Kristo cyangwa se ari Antikristo
Ariko jye n’inzu yanjye tuzakorera Yesu uwo

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1998
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Umunsi umwe

lines.text: Umunsi umwe Yesu azagaruka kujyana itorero rye
Kuri uwo munsi tuzaruhuka imibabaro yo mu isi,
Abizeye mwese mwihangane turi hafi kuruhuka
Nta marira azabayo, nta rupfu ruzabayo
Tuzaba turuhutse imiruho twaruhiye muri iyi si
Nta marira azabayo nta rupfu ruzabayo
Tuzaba turuhutse imiruho twaruhiye muri iyi si
Bashakashatsi bo muri iyi si munkundire mbibarize
Ko muzi byinshi mwaba muzi umunsi Yesu azagarukaho
Uwo munsi uzatungura benshi reka tubagire inama
Ibyiza nuko mwakwihana ibyaha mukakira umwami Yesu
Yesu azaza mu cyubahiro cye twese tuzamwibonera
Amavi yose azapfukamira uwo Mwami w'abami
Tuzahoberana n'abacu bose twaburiye muri iyi si
Icyubahiro ni icyawe Mwami ukwiriye icyubahiro
Icyubahiro ni icyawe Mwami ukwiriye icyubahiro

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Uwiteka uri umutabazi

lines.text: Mu ntambara turwana na wa mwanzi Satani
Mbese ni nde uhwanye nawe mu bari mu isi bose
Hagati mu bakomeye, mbese ni nde uhwanye nawe ?
Hagati mu bategeka, ni nde ukurusha ubutwari?
Wagaragaye ukomeye mu bari mu isi bose
Amahanga arakumenya ko uri Imana ya Isirayeli
Na Farawo yamenye y’uko uri Imana ikomeye
Mbese ni nde uhwanye nawe mu bari mu isi bose ?
Hagati mu bakomeye mbese ni nde uhwanye nawe ?
Hagati mu bategeka ni nde ukurusha ubutwari?

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na BIGIRIMANA Raymond
hymns.author: BIGIRIMANA Raymond

hymns.title: Yemwe torero

lines.text: Kuko tutazi umunsi cyangwa isaha Yesu azagarukaho.
Ibimenyetso tumaze kubona, ni byinshi cyane,
Umwami w’abami ari hafi kujyana itorero yapfiriye
Yewe mugenzi uri hehe? Uri hehe? Uri hehe?
Mu isi yose ni intambara, indwara n’inzara
Ku bw’ibyo mugenzi niwihane wizere Yesu urakizwa
Ibihe tugezemo mugenzi kwari ibyo kuba maso
Umwami w’Abami ari hafi kujyana itorero yapfiriye
Yewe mugenzi uri hehe? Uri hehe? Uri hehe?
Mu isi yose ni intambara, indwara n’inzara
Ku bw’ibyo mugenzi niwihane wizere Yesu urakizwa

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné,
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Igisubizo

lines.text: Mu nzira ijya i Damasiko ninde ?
Ni Yesu! Yesu,Yesu, Yesu uri igitangaza.
“ Mbese abantu banyita nde? bamwe ngo”
Abandi YoBose: -Hana umubatiza cyangwa uri umwe mu bahanuzi
Yesu nawe arababaza ati: ‘‘mbese namwe munyita nde’’ ?
Kubana na Yesu ntumumenye ni akaga !
Na Yohana mu nzu y'imbohe, yatumye abantu ngo bamubaze
Mbese ni wowe Mesiya, cyangwa dutegereze undi
Kandi ari we wamubatije, Yesu ibyawe birakomeye !
Hoziyana cyo tugende, tubibwire amoko yose
Bamenye ko ari Umwami utanga amahoro
Abo hirya n'abo hino, bakiboshywe na Satani
Bamenye ko ari umwami ubasha kubohora
Ni we se w'imfubyi zose umutware w'abapfakazi
N'indushyi zose zo mu isi Yesu abaruhure

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Igitabo cy’Imana

lines.text: Byatewe n’uko Yesu yaturutse mu ijuru
Wagiye imbere ya Kayafa umubwira ubutumwa,
Uti hari umunsi umwe ijuru rizakinguka
Muzabona umwana w’Imana aziye ku bicu,
Ariko warazutse none ubu uri muzima

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1999
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Itorero mu bihe bibi

lines.text: Ngo arwanye abacunguwe n’amaraso ya Yesu
Babiri bazaba bari mu buriri bumwe
Umwe azajyanwa undi na we asigare
Babiri bazaba bari gusya ku rusyo
Umwe azajyanwa undi na we asigare
Umwe azajyanwa undi na we asigare
Usigaye na we abure icyo yakora haa
Atahe mu rugo ngo agiye kureba abana
Iyoo! Abana na bo bose bigendeye
Nk’uko Mose yamanitse inzoka mu butayu
Ni ko Umwana w’Imana yamanitswe ku giti

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Mu ijuru habaye inama

lines.text: Ngo agende acungure abari mu isi iih
Muri abo bose nta n’umwe wemeye kudupfira
Uretse umwana w’ Imana wemeye kuba igita-mbo
Dore intare yo mu muryango wa Yuda
Afata cya gitabo amena ibimenyetso bigifatanyije
Amena icya mbere, amena icya kabiri
Inyenyeri zo mu ijuru zose zikubita hasi
Uko abami bo mu isi bazamwikubita imbere
Dore intare yo mu muryango wa Yuda

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Turagutegereje

lines.text: Ijoro rirakuze, habaye mu gicuku, habaye mu gicuku
Mu kabwibwi ku mugoroba, twari tukwiteguye
Ku mugoroba wa joro, twari tukwiteguye
Kuko tumaranira kuba mu bwiza bwawe
No kwihangana kwawe umva gusenga kwacu
Amavi yose azapfukama, amoko yose azaboroga
Nibabona cya kimenyetso cyo kuza k'Umwana w'Umuntu
Tuzaba turi kumwe nawe, tuzimana mu bwami bwawe
Ibitabo bizabumburwa, ducire ab’isi bose imanza
Uzatwibagiza agahinda n’urupfu byo muri iyi si mbi
Ibyishimo n’umunezero bizahora ku mitwe yacu
Ibizima bine bizajya bivuga biti: ‘‘Uwera, Uwera’’
Abakuru makumyabiri na bane bati: ‘‘Uwera Uwera’’
Itorero rivuye mu isi rizavuga ngo: Uwera Uwera
Mbe Mwami ni ryari mbe Mwami ni ryari
Mbe Mwami ni ryari ? /3 Igihe uzagarukira

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1988
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Tuza wa nyanja we

lines.text: Tuza! Tuza tuza wa nyanja tuza
Itorero ni nk’ubwato buri mu nyanja
Iyi si mubona tuyicamo tujya mu ijuru
Iyi si mubona tuyicamo tujya mu ijuru
Iyi si mubona tuyicamo tujya mu ijuru
Hakurya y’ibi mubona, hakurya y’iyi mibabaro
Hakurya yo guhunga, hakurya y’izi ntambara
Hakurya yo gusenyerwa amazu twiyubakiye eeh

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na BIGIRIMANA Raymond
hymns.author: BIGIRIMANA Raymond

hymns.title: Umwuka w’Uwiteka

lines.text: Mbese abasaruzi bo barava he he ?
Ngo bave mu Rwanda bakwire hose
Umwuka w’Uwiteka ari hamwe na njye

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1999
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Vuba vuba

lines.text: Umwami w’abami azagaruka kujyana itorero rye
Itorero rye, itorero rye, kujya kuruhuka
Na bya bizima bine bimupfukamira uwo Mwami
Na bya bizima bine bimupfukamira uwo Mwami
Uri Uwera, uri Uwera uri Uwera’’
Tuzashima Umwami wacu kuko ari Uwera
Uri Uwera, uri Uwera uri Uwera
Ifarashi y’umweru, uwo Mwami ni uwo kwizerwa
Uwo Mwami w’abami kuko ari Uwera
Uri Uwera, uri Uwera, uri Uwera
Les choix que nous avons faits,
Ce n’est pas par hasard que nous avons choisi Jésus,
Jésus le Roi des roi, ooh Jésus notre Sauveur

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné .
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné .

hymns.title: Yesu ndagumana nawe

lines.text: Uhereye kera kose uri ubuturo bwacu
Mvuye mu gihugu cy’uburiganya bwa Satani
Nje kuba mu isi y’Umwuka mparindirire Yesu
Umuntu wese uza aho uri, ntabwo uzamwirukana
Ibyo wakoreye mu isi byangiye ku mutima
None ndaje mbe itabaza rimurikira abandi
Ngo bave mu irimbukiro bajye mu bwiza bwawe
Ndafata icyo wamfatiye ngo ngere ku rugero
Niba ngira imibabaro niba nkena nkanenwa

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim,1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1998
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Urukundo

lines.text: N’aho nagira impano yo guhanura cyane
Nkabasha no gukura imisozi nta rukundo ntacyo naba ndi cyo
Nta rukundo nta cyo waba uri cyo

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Dufite Imana

lines.text: Wa muja wo kwa Namani ni we wabwiye nyirabuja ati:
Yari umuntu ukomeye cyane muri icyo gihugu
Yari umutoni kuri shebuja akaba n’umunyacyubahiro
Y’uko muri Isiraheli Hariho Imana /2 n’abahanuzi
Si njye Mana yica kandi ikabeshaho’’
Namani ageze kwa Elisa, Elisa aramubwira ati:
Namani amaze gukira avuga n’ijwi rirenga
Nemeye y’uko nta yindi Mana iriho mu isi

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Humura imana irakuzi

lines.text: Ni uko Yesu kristo agira neza
Uyizi arahari ni we ukubwira ati:
Dore yaguciye nk'imanzi mu kiganza cye
Ubwo Yesu yababajwe yumva neza uko ubabaye

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na TUYISENGE Christian,1978- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2008
hymns.author: TUYISENGE Christian

hymns.title: Isi izahinda umushyitsi

lines.text: Agahenge ubu ifite ni uko abakiranutsi bakiyirimo
Icyo gihe ni bwo bazemera ko kubaha Uwiteka aribwo bwenge
Benshi bazajarajara bashaka ijambo ry’Imana baribure
Abimitse Yesu mu mitima yabo ooh
Yesu, Yesu uri mwiza, uri mwiza
Yesu uu ,Yesu Mwami wacu ooh, Yesu , Yesu, Yesu
Yesu uu, reka tugupfukamire ee, Yesu, Yesu, Yesu

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Ni byiza

lines.text: Ati: ‘‘Data ubababarire kuko batazi icyo bakora’’
Imbaraga z’Umwuka wera ni zo zizatuzamura
Ubwo abapfuye bazazurwa ndetse natwe abakiriho
Wizere Imana Data, Umwana n’Umwuka wera

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na TUYISENGE Christian , 1978- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2008
hymns.author: TUYISENGE Christian

hymns.title: Reka nirate umusaraba

lines.text: Reka tuwamamaze ni wo ntsinzi yacu
Uwo musaraba wa Yesu ni intsinzi yacu
Mwami Yesu yakoze kuri uwo musaraba
Kugira ngo jye na we turokoke
Wa mwenda wari ukingirije ahe-hera aa
Abivuga hejuru n’ijwi rirenga ku bw’uwo musaraba
Arudukuzaho no kurubamba kuri wa musaraba
Ubu ngubu nitwe tugezweho Yesu ni we gakiza kacu
Ubu ngubu nitwe tugezweho, Yesu ni we Haleluya

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné

hymns.title: Mumaranishe imibabaro

lines.text: Turi hafi yo gutaha, iwacu mu ijuru
N’ubwo tugenda, mu nzira dusa n'abandi
Ariko twebwe abakijijwe, dufite ibanga aa
Ariko kuri twe abakijijwe igihe ni gito
Yesu akagaruka akaturuhura imibabaro yose ee
Nawe munyabyaha wumva iyi nkuru hunga urupfu
Kuko Yesu agukunda muzabane mu ijuru

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe n’UWIMANA Chantal, 1983 - ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2007
hymns.author: UWIMANA Chantal

hymns.title: Ubwiza bwa Yesu

lines.text: Iyo turi mu bibazo Mwami ntujya udutererana
Iyo turi mu makuba aho niho wigaragariza
Iyo usuye umupfakazi yibagirwa ko yigeze gupfakara
Reka gikwire mu isi no mu ijuru
Muri iki gitabo iboneka kuri Page 72, numero 67
Muri iki gitabo iboneka kuri Page 18, ifite numero 6

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUSAGARA Dieudonné .
hymns.author: RUSAGARA Dieudonné .

hymns.title: Kunesha kwacu

lines.text: Bo bibwiye ko atazazuka, niko kwishima ko Yesu apfuye
Mu kanya gato aba arazutse, maze kunesha kuraboneka
Satani mubi aho yicaye, yishimira ko Yesu yabambwe
Muri ibyo byishimo afatwa mpiri, n’Umwami Yesu
Umwami Yesu aramufata, nibwo amwambuye urufunguzo
Maze azukana icyubahiro, ubwo atsindira itorero rye
Ibinyamajwi birangurure, maze abaremwe bavuze impundu
Urupfu ntabwo tukirutinya, rwahindutse inzira y’ubusamo

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na RUGEMANGENZI Martin, 1959 - ; Hari mu mwaka w’1988
hymns.author: RUGEMANGENZI Martin

hymns.title: Tuje mu nzu yawe

lines.text: Tuje mu nzu yawe tuzanye ibitambo by’ishimwe
Twinjiye mu nzu yawe Mwami ngo tuguhimbaze
Tuva mu Egiputa aho Satani yicira abantu
Duca mu butayu bunini buteye ubwoba
Inkweto zo mu birenge byacu nazo ni uko

hymns.credit: Yahinduwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961 - ; Hari mu mwaka w’ 1991
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Twishime tunezerwe

lines.text: Haleluya kuko Umwami Imana yacu ishobora byose
Haleluya kuko Umwami Imana yacu iri ku ngoma
Haleluya kuko Umwami Imana yacu Ishobora byose
Haleluya kuko Umwami Imana yacu Iri ku ngoma
Hallelujah, for the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
Hallelujah, for the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.

hymns.credit: Yahinduwe na TUYISHIMIRE Prudence ; Yanditswe na Paul Wilbur, 1951 -
hymns.author: TUYISHIMIRE Prudence ; Yanditswe na Paul Wilbur

hymns.title: Sanga Yesu

lines.text: Sanga Yesu ni Umwami, arambuye amaboko
Yemeye gupfa rubi atanga ubugingo bwe
Niwumvira iryo jwi rye rihamagara a
Mbese ufite amahoro muri uwo mwijima

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na MUNYANKINDI Ezekiel,1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1985
hymns.author: MUNYANKINDI Ezekiel

hymns.title: Ubwo Yesu ahari

lines.text: Ubwo Yesu ahari nta bwoba mfite
Mu mumbwirire ko nkiri mu nzira
Hirya y’izuba, hirya y’ukwezi hirya y’inyenyeri ii,
Nyir’icyo gihugu, turaziranye, ngiye gutura iwe.
Hirya y’izuba hirya y’ukwezi, hirya y’inyenyeri,
Nzasangayo Yesu nzakirwa neza azambona amenye.

hymns.credit: Yahinduwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961- ; Yayihinduye mu mwaka w’ 1998
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: I Gologota ku giti

lines.text: I Gologota ku giti, niho Yesu yabambwe
Umwe muri bo aramutakambira, Mwami uzabyibuke.
Nzaba nambutse wa mugezi mvuye mu isi y’imibabaro
Muri rwa rurembo rwera, Mwami uzanyibuka
Bamwishe urupfu rw’isoni kuri wa musaraba,
Mu rubavu rw’ umukiza havubutsemo isoko
Yoza uyu mutima wanjye Mwami uzanyibuke.

hymns.credit: Yahinduwe n’Alexis DUSABE, 1978 -
hymns.author: Alexis DUSABE

hymns.title: Umwami Yesu agiye kujya mu ijuru
hymns.titleUpper: UMWAMI YESU AGIYE KUJYA MU IJURU

lines.text: Umwami Yesu agiye kujya mu ijuru yasize avuze
Muzaba abagabo bo kumpamya i Yerusalemu n’ i
Yudaya n’i Samaliya no kumpera y’ isi
Ariko Umwuka Wera namanuka zatsinda ab’isi
Isezerano ryiza ko azagaruka kutujyana nitumwitegure
Ayo mavuta tuvuga ni Umwuka Wera
Ni we ngwate y’abaragwa b’ubugingo buhoraho

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na MUNYANKINDI Ezekiel, 1961-
hymns.author: MUNYANKINDI Ezekiel

hymns.title: Uwiteka uri mwiza

lines.text: Ibyo wibwira kuri twe ni byiza
Aah mu nzira ze iminsi yose

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe n’Itsinda ry’Abahimbyi,
hymns.author: Itsinda ry’Abahimbyi

hymns.title: Betelehemu

lines.text: N’ubwo uri muto, ntabwo uri mutoya
Uzakiza abari mu isi ibyaha byabo
Mu gihe cya kera yateye igisuzuguriro
Igihugu cya Zeburoni n’icy a Nafutali
Abantu bagenderaga mu mu ijima mwinshi
Ubutware bwe buzaba ku bitugu bye
Natwe Yesu yaduhaye ayo mahoro, yatwambitse
Mu kimbo cy’ubwihebe kungoma ye hazaba amahoro
Menshi iii, azaca intambara zose zishireho kuko
Data wa twese ni Umwami w’amahoro

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 1979
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Umuhamagaro

lines.text: No kwagura ubwami bwawe mu isi

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim,1961- ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2012
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Rabagirana Yerusalemu

lines.text: Dore muri iyi si siho iwacu

hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Naguzwe amaraso y’Intama

lines.text: Naguzwe amaraso y’Intama, nshunguzwa imbabazi zayo
Noneho ndi umwana wayo, nzajya mbyamamaza hose
Yesu nyir’zina ryiza, riruta amazina yose
Ni umutware w’abatware, ni we Mwami utwara abami
Nimuvuge ako gakiza, mwature uwo munezero
Naomi, Orupa, Rusi ba bagore babajwe
Satani yandashe imyambi ngo nkunde nivuguruze
Abeli, Yobu, Yabesi ba bagabo babajwe
Satani yandashe imyambi ngo nkunde nivuguruze
Yesu Krisito muture mu mahoro ye
Mwami nshaka ko tubana aho uzaba ni ho nzaba
(U)bwoko bwawe nibwo bwanjye Imana yawe niyo yanjye
Ni wowe nshuti magara nkubitsa amabanga yose
Ibyiza wakoreye umu-tima wanjye ubizi neza
Amatsiko n’urukumbu- zi byo mu bugingo bwanjye
Umuriro wawe waka mu magufwa yanjye yose
Nkibuka ko uri umutware, nanjye ndi igisonga cyawe.
Nibaza uko bizamera wa munsi tuzabonana
(Noneho ntuzanyihisha ngo mbe mu isi ube mu ijuru.)

hymns.credit: Yanditswe na Pasitori RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961 - Yayanditse mu mwaka w’ 2012
hymns.author: RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Wabaye ingumba

lines.text: Wabaye ingumba nk’igiti ii cy’ibibabi gusa
Wishushanya nk’umukristo nyawe ariko ibyawe byose
Bizwi neza n’umukiza Yesu urondora imitima
Wazanye n’abandi mu gakiza wowe wanga gukizwa
Ntiwanyuze mu irembo ry’ukuri kuko wuriye inkike
Wahagaze ku rugi ubuza abandi kwinjira
Abeli na Enoki, Aburahamu na Mose
Yewe uwishushanya we mbese ko utanditsemo
Ni iki gituma wanga kwiyegurira Yesu
Ibuka uko ahora uku-bwiri-ra mu ijambo rye
Ibuka uko yagiye agutumaho intumwa ze

hymns.credit: Yanditswe na Pst. RUSHEMA Efraim, 1961-; Akoresheje ijwi ry’indi ndir., mu w’ 1988
hymns.author: Pst. RUSHEMA Efraim

hymns.title: Twari abanyamahanga

lines.text: Twari mu isi tudafite Imana rurema
Ku bwa kavukire twari abo kwangwa n’Imana
Ariko kuko Imana ari umutunzi w'imbabazi
Nashyirwe hejuru kuko ataheze mu mva

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na MUJAWIMANA Madeleine, 1983 - , Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2011
hymns.author: MUJAWIMANA Madeleine

hymns.title: Iherezo

lines.text: Nyamara iherezo rya byose riri bugufi
Abibone bose n'inkozi z'ibibi bazaba ibishingwe
Ukiranirwa nawe nareke ibyo yibwira agarukire Uwiteka;
Tugire umwete wo gusenga twezwe cyane

hymns.credit: Yanditswe na TUYISHIME Jonathan, 1981 ; Yatunganijwe mu mwaka w’ 2016
hymns.author: TUYISHIME Jonathan

hymns.title: Nzaboherereza umufasha

lines.text: Ariko amaze kumuhabwa ahamya ashize amanga
Yarazutse ni we ukoze ibi mureba
Uwo Mwuka atuyobora mu kuri kwose

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na MUJAWIMANA Madeleine, 1983 - ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2012
hymns.author: MUJAWIMANA Madeleine

hymns.title: Nta Jambo

lines.text: Nta Jambo, nta butware, nta muntu, nta mbaraga
Nta bushobozi biri hejuru y’izina rya Yesu
Petero na Yohana ku irembo ryitwa ryiza
Baramubwira bati: nta feza n'izahabu dufite
Mu izina rya Yesu twizeye haguruka aa
Niba mwarasogongeye, mukamenya ko Yesu agira neza

hymns.credit: Yanditswe mu w’ 2016 na MUJAWIMANA Madeleine, 1983 - ; Yatunganijwe 2018

hymns.title: Yemwe abatuye isi

lines.text: Yemwe abatuye isi mwese, nimwumve inkuru nziza
Umwana w'Imana yavutse niwe muremyi w'isi nijuru
Kibe icy' Imana yo mu ijuru
Kugira ngo agakiza kagere kubo mu isi bose
Yahanuwe kuva kera uyu munsi yatuvukiye
Icyubahiro kibe icy'Imana yo mu ijuru
Kandi amahoro abe mu bantu Imana yishimira

hymns.credit: Yanditswe na MUTABAZI Bonfils, 1987 - ; Yatunganijwe mu mwaka w’ 2017
hymns.author: MUTABAZI Bonfils

hymns.title: Yewe beterehemu

lines.text: Niwe mucunguzi w'abari mu isi yose
Abo mu isi mwese muze tumuhimbaze
Yakoze ibitangaza byinshi hano mu isi

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na Isaac RABINI RUHIGISHA, 1988 , Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2014
hymns.author: Isaac RABINI RUHIGISHA

hymns.title: Ukuvuka kwa Yesu

lines.text: Ukuvuka kwa Yesu uu, kwabaye igisubizo
Ku kibazo cy’umuntu wari uwo kurimbuka
‘‘Nawe Betelehemu ho mu gihugu cya Yuda
Ni ukuri nturi muto, mu midugudu ya Yuda
Kuko dore muri wowe hazaturuka umutware
Umwuka w’Uwiteka azaba ari kuri we
Balamu yamuvuzeho ati: “ndamureba ariko si ubu
Inyenyeri izakomoka mu rubyaro rwa Yakobo
Kandi inkoni y’ubwami izaboneka mu Isirayeli’’
Twishime tunezerwe eeh Noheli nziza kuri twese

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na MUJAWIMANA Madeleine, 1983 - ; Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2014
hymns.author: MUJAWIMANA Madeleine

hymns.title: Wakire ibiguhumurira neza

lines.text: Bwiza bw’izina rye mu mutima wanjye,

hymns.credit: Yahinduwe n’ Alexis DUSABE, 1978 - & MUNYANDAMUTSA Bruce, 1989 -
hymns.author: Alexis DUSABE

hymns.title: Kwizera

lines.text: Kwizera ni ukumenya rwose, ibyiringirwa Imana yavuze
Hahirwa umuntu wiringira, ibyo Uwiteka Imana yavuze
Kuko bitazabura gusohora, naho byatinda ntibihera
Batumbiraga gakondo yabo, wa murwa wera w'Imana
Abandi baciwe ibihanga, bazererezwa banyazwe n'ibyabo
N’ibyaha bijya bitwizingiraho, dutumbira Yesu wenyine
Imana y'amahoro ibeze, umwuka, ubugingo, n'umubiri
Birarindwe bitabaho umugayo, kugeza ku munsi w'Umwami

hymns.credit: Yahinduwe na Alexis DUSABE,1978 -
hymns.author: Alexis DUSABE

hymns.title: Mu ijuru ni heza

lines.text: Mu ijuru ni heza! Niringiye kuzabayo
Iri mu ijuru ku Mana Data
Nzasiga iyi si yanshavuzaga ijoro n'amanywa
Nigire mu ijuru hataba umubabaro n'amarira
Tuzibera mu gitaramo turirimbe indirimbo nshya
Mwenedata ngwino mu isi nta mahoro

hymns.credit: Yanditswe na TUYISHIME Jonathan,1981 ; Yatunganijwe mu mwaka w’ 2008
hymns.author: TUYISHIME Jonathan

hymns.title: Nk’uko byahamijwe

lines.text: Ku ngoma ye azaba ari ibyishimo
Ku ngoma ye azaba ari ibyishimo bifite ishingiro
Njye ndabihamya neza kuko mbifitiye gihamya
Yagiye mu ijuru kudutegurira ibyicaro byiza
Tujyanwe aheza ibudapfa mu ijuru iwacu
Mbega ibyishimo tuzagira mu juru iwacu
Nuko mube maso kuko mutazi umunsi cyangwa igihe

hymns.credit: Yanditswe na TUYISABE Bahati, 1982 - , Yatunganijwe mu mwaka w’ 2011
hymns.author: TUYISABE Bahati

hymns.title: Nzamwitegereza

lines.text: Icyo tuzi ni uko Yesu niyerekanwa

hymns.credit: Yahimbwe na MUJAWIMANA Madeleine,1983- Yayihimbye mu mwaka w’ 2013
hymns.author: MUJAWIMANA Madeleine

hymns.title: Hariho umusozi

lines.text: Ni ho bajyaga babamba abantu b'ibivume
Ni we wambabariye, ni we wancunguye
Kubwa kavukire yanjye nari uwo gucirwaho iteka
Yesu abwira abigishwa be ati: “tujye i Yerusalemu
Ariko ku munsi wa gatatu azazuka
Yacunguriye abantu Imana, yatwunze na Data
Yakinguriye abera rwa rurembo rwo mu ijuru
Abatari ubwoko waduhaye umugabane mu ijuru

hymns.credit: Yanditswe na MUTABAZI Bonfils, 1987 , Yatunganijwe mu mwaka w’ 2017
hymns.author: MUTABAZI Bonfils

hymns.title: Zirikana agakiza

lines.text: Ubwo Yesu yari hejuru mu mpinga

hymns.credit: Yanditswe n’UWINEZA Rosine, 1985 - ,Yatunganijwe mu mwaka w’ 2018
hymns.author: UWINEZA Rosine

hymns.title: Turi abana b’Imana

lines.text: Ntitukiri imbata ngo tugire ubwoba hoya
Igihe abisirayeli bari imbata za Farawo
Ariko noneho ubwo twabatuwe ku byaha
Ubu turi Abahungu n’Abakobwa b’Imana Data
Ubu turi abahungu n’abakobwa b’Imana Data

hymns.credit: Yanditswe na TUYISENGE Christian, 1978 ; Yatunganijwe mu mwaka w’ 2018
hymns.author: TUYISENGE Christian

hymns.title: Umwana yatuvukiye

lines.text: Kandi ubutware buzaba ku bitugu bye
Nta kintu na kimwe kitaremwe nawe

hymns.credit: Yanditswe mu mwaka w’ 2017 na MUJAWIMANA Madeleine, 1983 - Yatunganijwe mu mwaka w’ 2018
